title: Badi Bahen
desc: Jyoti, a girl found by the riverbank, is adopted by a gardener who works for a wealthy family. Years later, she finally finds her true identity amidst love, deceit and twists of fate.

title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
desc: As a newly graduated engineer loses track of what's important, his career starts to rise. When he falls in love with a beautiful young woman, he gets even more confused about what he wants.

title: Preetam
desc: Raised by his aunt and uncle, orphaned Preetam grows up to become a man who cares for others; Preetam and Anil grow up like brothers, but dark undercurrents of a messy past threaten to destroy the solace and peace Preetam has in his present.
